scientific_integrity: Infinite-family theorem is proved using local population escape and a two-bit gate. Explicit computational verification is corroborative only; originality has not been independently established.
scientific_limitations: Constant homogeneous up/down thresholds differing by two; complete graphs, each with one fixed repeated sequential permutation update, n>=3 and 1<=k<=n-2. Neither other graph types, other gaps, time-varying thresholds, nor other update schedules are claimed. An inaccessible 2015 generalized multi-threshold treatment leaves a stated possible historical-equivalence risk.
title: An isolated parity two-cycle and binomial relaxation shell in sequential bi-threshold cliques
